mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduler_execution_log (scheduler_name, status, execution_message, started_at) VALUES (#{schedulerName}, #{status}, #{executionMessage}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduler_execution_log SET status = #{status}, execution_message = #{executionMessage}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduler_execution_log WHERE scheduler_name = #{schedulerName} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduler_execution_log SET status = 'FAILED', execution_message = #{executionMessage}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE scheduler_name = #{schedulerName} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < #{timeoutBefore}
